description: A Pure Data external providing a high-level English text-to-speech interface based on the libflite synthesis library. The pd-externals repository documents the external, while Debian also identifies that repository as the upstream source for pd-flite.

research.notes: The repository history incorporates the maintained 0.3.3 line; searches also found an earlier/update repository under Lucarda, but current upstream and Debian evidence favor pd-externals/flite.
